subject.title: feat(hooks): emit session prune lifecycle event

question: What `session:prune` contract should OpenClaw support before this PR is ported: bounded metadata only, richer trusted opt-in data, or no core pruning hook yet?
rationale: The source gap is real, but the permanent hook decides what session/tool metadata may leave context pruning and whether handler latency can block prompt construction.

options.title: Metadata-only bounded hook
options.body: Port the hook to the active pruning path with counts, timestamp, typed session identity when available, and sanitized bounded tool metadata only.

options.title: Trusted richer payload
options.body: Allow richer prune details only behind an explicit trusted opt-in after documenting privacy, escaping, size, timeout, and logging expectations.

options.title: Defer core hook
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and leave scheduled indexing as the workaround until a broader memory/pruning hook design is approved.

recommendation.title: Metadata-only bounded hook
recommendation.body: Port the hook to the active pruning path with counts, timestamp, typed session identity when available, and sanitized bounded tool metadata only.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns this implementation candidate and has the strongest adjacent hook-surface history in the inspected commits.
